top_signals.title: Japan Household Outlays Fall Most Since Pandemic
top_signals.summary: Japan’s household spending fell by the most since 2020, highlighting persistent weakness in consumption, even as the Bank of Japan grows more confident that inflation has become entrenched enough to warrant further interest-rate increases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: How the world became too reliant on Jensen Huang
top_signals.summary: The chief executive’s travails are a reminder that a single point of failure is never a good thing for a big company
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
